_comment: Nero rollout configuration. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY THING YOU CHANGE TO MOVE A USER OR BRANCH. No redeploy, no code edit. The bot re-reads it on every Mini App open.
_kill: true = every user goes to legacy on their next open. The <1 minute rollback.

allow._users: Wave 1: Хусейин (owner), Хасанбей, Абдулатиф (trusted barista). REPLACE WITH REAL TELEGRAM IDs BEFORE GO-LIVE.
allow._branches: Branch ids that get Nero wholesale. Empty during wave 1.

deny._users: Beats allow and rollout. Use to pull one person back instantly without touching the wave.

rollout._percent: 100 = HERKES Nero'da (2026-08-04 tam geçiş). Geri alma: kill:true ya da percent:0.

development._note: Mutable path. Anyone may deploy at any time.

staging._note: Separate bot token AND separate storage. Never points at production data.

production._note: Immutable versioned paths. Never overwrite a live build — publish a new folder and repoint.

clientGuard._enforce: KAPALI. Yönlendirmeyi bot yapıyor (build_webapp_url). Pakete gömülü config zamanla eskiyeceği için içerideki koruma yanlış karar verebilirdi — kapatıldı.

waves.exit: 3 clean closings, kassa matches to the sum, no rollback
7 consecutive days, all shift types incl. trainee closing and пересменка
one full payroll cycle closed on Nero

_rosterNote: slot → Telegram ID. Written by Rollout Console; ignored by the resolver. Never infer identity from allow.users order.
